request: Analyze GSE319603 for PMID 41835150 (Transcriptomic insights into aerobic exercise-mediated attenuation of high-fat diet-induced muscle wasting.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk mRNA-seq (paired-end, Illumina NovaSeq 6000), mouse gastrocnemius muscle (S2.7.p1)
final.design_in_paper: 4 groups randomized at 4 weeks of age, n=12/group: chow (C), chow+MICT (CM), HFD (H), HFD+MICT (HM); HFD weeks 1-21; MICT treadmill weeks 14-21, 45 min/day, 5 d/wk (S2.1.p1, S2.2.p1). RNA-seq on n=6/group for C, H, HM only; CM was not sequenced (S2.7.p1, S3.2.p1, FIG3).
final.sample_inclusion: 18 GSMs = C1-6, H1-6, HM1-6; no exclusions stated
final.primary_estimand: Effect of 8-week MICT on gastrocnemius gene expression in HFD-fed mice: HM vs H (exercise effect under HFD; S3.2.p1, S4.p7-p9). H vs C is the diet (non-exercise) effect reported alongside.
planned_contrasts: HM vs H (S3.2.p1; paper: 563 DEGs, 213 up / 350 down) - exercise contrast
H vs C (S3.2.p1; paper: 458 DEGs, 295 up / 163 down) - diet contrast, not exercise
final.repeated_measure_unit: none; one sample per mouse, independent animals
final.normalization: DESeq2 median-of-ratios on featureCounts raw counts (S2.7.p1)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 v1.22.2 on raw counts, BH FDR (S2.7.p1); model scope (all samples vs pairwise subsets) not stated
final.paper_results: Table 1/2 top-50 DEGs; MICT downregulates Foxo1, Fbxo32, Trim63, Txnip, Pdk4, Angptl4; minimal change in Pax7, Myod1, Myog (S3.5.p1, S4.p8)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Methods S2.7.p1 state DESeq2 on raw counts with FDR<0.05; Results S3.2.p1 state the DEG criteria actually used for the reported counts: adjusted P<0.05 and |log2FC| >= 0.5. The Results rule is the one that produced 458/563, so it is the paper threshold; the Methods FDR-only rule is kept as an audit rule. Only C, H, HM were sequenced, so the only exercise contrast available is HM vs H (exercise under HFD); there is no chow exercise (CM) arm in the data.

GEO treatment_protocol text is the paper's S2.2.p1 exercise protocol; data_processing matches S2.7.p1 (Trim-galore, STAR, featureCounts, GRCm38.p6)
matrix GSE319603_All_gene_counts.csv columns C1-6, H1-6, HM1-6 equal the GEO library names
